title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(河野昭彦研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Kono Akihiko)
keywords: Energy storage technology literacy 2.Electricity storage device 3.Electrochemical energy conversion 4.Battery model
educationalGoal: [Theme] Set a theme for mastering the battery (storage technology literacy). Through this research, as an electrical specialist, understand the social and technical background of power storage technology. And learn how to solve problems and how to make presentations. [Goal] Proprietary achievements based on conventional research on project themes to be implemented, The results are summarized as a paper.
advice: [Summary of class] Conduct research activities alone or in groups. A weekly meeting is held and the status is reported in an activity weekly report based on daily communication. The annual schedule is as follows. (1) First semester: Follow the project proposal to create a research schedule for the research content of the previous semester and conduct research. Start. Learn the basics of research and research related literature. Submit an activity weekly report to accelerate the plan. Learn the process of making corrections quickly. The results of the semester will be summarized and announced in June and August. (2) Second semester: Keeping the final report in mind, continue research activities, prepare weekly reports, and stimulate discussion. We will hold briefing sessions in October and December, aiming to improve presentation skills. The results will be compiled into a paper and presented at the public presentation review meeting. In addition, we will compile the transfer materials for students in the next year.
requiredKnowledge: 1.Energy storage technology is a discipline study, from the viewpoint of social infrastructure for environmental issues and energy issues, electrochemical energy conversion that handles atomic behavior, and device modeling necessary for practical application of equipment. A wide range of knowledge is required. 2.Obtain better problem solving through communication with supervisors, seniors, and classmates. 3.Understand the necessity and rules of safety and health activities, personal information protection and confidential information protection.
